summary: The count that pays a customer and the sort that bills distributors answer different questions.
realLife: In 2023 testimony on Maine LD 1909, outgoing CLYNK CEO Alison Vanderhoof distinguished the conveyor count for each consumer from the later mechanical scan and sort used to invoice deposit initiators. In its February 2026 report DEP expected sales data to be used to divide costs under full pooling. It described that method as prospective while formal rulemaking was underway.
gates: A customer credit and a disputed distributor invoice refer to the same processing run.
